title: Bream Carpaccio with Tomato Confit Sauce Vierge
ldName: Bream carpaccio with tomato confit sauce vierge
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 sea bream, very fresh, filleted and skinned
1 garlic clove, grated to a paste
1 handful of basil leaves, finely chopped
1 handful of flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
150ml of extra virgin olive oil, plus extra to loosen, if needed
1/2 small red onion, very finely sliced
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine all the ingredients for the sauce with some salt and pepper and mix well
Slice the fish very thinly and arrange on a serving platter. Top with the sauce and serve immediately
